items.title: Clayton Duerr Interview, 1972-04-17
items.q: And Laurie, then Laurie, then we made that brush.

ctx.x: Do you remember any numbers like Annie Laurie? Did you make that or not? Maybe. Did that come out about the same time?

How about the same time? That's why I'm checking. It probably was then. I just can't remember. Do you remember Loch Lomond? Yeah, Loch Lomond. That's what they did that. Yeah, that's it. Yeah, Loch Lomond. And Laurie, then Laurie, then we made that brush. Yeah. And what's some of the others? I can't remember.
Well, they made Where's the Waiter? Yeah, yeah, yeah.
